radiant_cleave.name: Radiant Cleave
radiant_cleave.desc: A sweeping arc of sunlit steel. Deals heavy Light damage in a wide arc.

aegis_of_dawn.name: Aegis of Dawn
aegis_of_dawn.desc: Wreathe yourself in dawnlight, reducing damage taken by 45% for 6 seconds and healing 10% of maximum health.

sunlance.name: Sunlance
sunlance.desc: Hurl a lance of condensed light that pierces up to 3 enemies.

judgment_circle.name: Judgment Circle
judgment_circle.desc: Call a sigil of judgment at the cursor. After a moment it erupts, damaging and stunning enemies.

ascendant_wrath.name: Ascendant Wrath
ascendant_wrath.desc: ULTIMATE. Rise on wings of light and crash down, devastating everything around you.

dawnblade_discipline.name: Dawnblade Discipline
dawnblade_discipline.desc: Passive. +2% critical chance and +4% damage per rank.

infernal_flurry.name: Infernal Flurry
infernal_flurry.desc: Three blazing cuts in a heartbeat. Each hit sets enemies Burning.

shadowstep.name: Shadowstep
shadowstep.desc: Vanish and reappear toward the cursor, cutting everything along the path.

hellfire_orb.name: Hellfire Orb
hellfire_orb.desc: A slow orb of hellfire that explodes on impact, burning everything nearby.

brimstone_nova.name: Brimstone Nova
brimstone_nova.desc: Release a ring of black fire around you, hurling enemies back.

demonform.name: Demonform
demonform.desc: ULTIMATE. Unleash the bound demon: +50% attack speed, +30% damage and 10% life steal for 10 seconds.

cinder_veins.name: Cinder Veins
cinder_veins.desc: Passive. +5% attack speed and +2% movement speed per rank.

arcane_shot.name: Arcane Shot
arcane_shot.desc: A rune-etched arrow that pierces one enemy.

split_volley.name: Split Volley
split_volley.desc: Loose five arrows in a fan.

frost_snare.name: Frost Snare
frost_snare.desc: Place a rune trap at the cursor. When an enemy steps on it, it bursts, chilling all nearby enemies.

gale_leap.name: Gale Leap
gale_leap.desc: Leap away from the cursor on a gust of wind.

starfall.name: Starfall
starfall.desc: ULTIMATE. Pull a dying star down onto the cursor.

keen_sight.name: Keen Sight
keen_sight.desc: Passive. +3% critical chance and +3% damage per rank.
